categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Touches src/validation.cpp, but only alters chainstate and block file flush error handling, with no effect on mempool or transaction relay policy.
categories.rationale: The change strictly affects chainstate flushing and does not touch mempool acceptance or transaction relay.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies FlushStateToDisk in src/validation.cpp.
categories.rationale: Stops writing coins cache entries and block-index metadata when block or undo data fails to flush to disk, preventing on-disk corruption. As noted in the discussion, when block data is stored on a separate filesystem (-blocksdir), continuing to advance m_last_flushed_block despite an fsync failure leaves metadata inconsistent with missing or corrupted block files.
